ios.desc:
Meta Meme is the meme maker made for people who actually run meme pages. Download videos from anywhere, generate viral memes with proven formats, and edit with tools that actually work.
Scroll. Save. Meme.

CREATE WITH VIDEO OR IMAGE
- Use videos from our library, your album or download from anywhere
- Use images from your photo library
- Search and use GIFs from GIPHY
- Video features require Pro

VIDEO DOWNLOADER (Pro)
- Use videos from TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, and more
- Works with Reels, Shorts, posts, stories, long videos, all of it
- Clean source files, not screen recordings or burned in watermarks
- Drops straight into the editor, ready to meme

GENERATE MEMES WITH AI (Pro)
- Instantly generate memes using Generative AI
- AI pulls from real meme formats and styles
- No random images, no low-effort captions
- Edit, customize, and export instantly

UNLIMITED IMAGES & CAPTIONS
- Add unlimited images to a single meme (Pro)
- Add unlimited text labels
- Full control over positioning, size, and rotation
- Browse the Meme Image Library with hundreds of images

VIDEO & GIF TOOLS (Pro)
- Search GIFs by keyword (via GIPHY)
- Trim video start and end times
- Export high-quality video memes

OBJECT TRACKING (Pro)
- Pin text or images to moving objects in video
- Text and stickers follow the object automatically
- Perfect for labeling people, objects, or anything that moves

MEME TEMPLATES
- Multi-label templates
- Multi-image layouts (side-by-side, grids, vertical, and more)
- Free classic templates (Top/Bottom Text, Advice Animal, etc.)
- (Some templates require Pro)

FULL CUSTOMIZATION
- Resize, crop, and reposition images or video
- Dozens of fonts
- Full control over font size and color
- Choose any background color
- Add stickers

CUSTOM WATERMARK (Pro)
- Add your own text or image watermark
- Use your logo
- Customize size, color, position, and rotation
- Remove the default Meta Meme watermark

Go Pro to Unlock Everything
- Video downloader (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Reddit, X, and more)
- Generative AI meme creation
- Create video memes
- Unlimited images and text labels
- Custom watermarks
- All premium templates
- Full meme image library
- No default watermark

Subscription Details
- Subscriptions are charged to your iTunes account
- Auto-renewing unless canceled at least 24 hours before renewal
- Manage or cancel anytime in Account Settings
- Free trials convert to paid subscriptions unless canceled
- Privacy Policy: https://meta-meme.
